purpose: Frozen grading authority for the northwind dual-site brownfield estate; live research is separately required by the task.

sources.title: Upgrade failure for vCenter 8.0 U3j, ESXi 8.0 U3j, and NSX 4.2.4 due to back-in-time restriction
factsPinned: VCF 9.1.0.0 BOM examples identify NSX 9.1.0.0.25318225, vCenter 9.1.0.0.25370922, and ESXi 9.1.0.0.25370933.
A chronologically newer source build cannot be moved backward to an older target build.

sources.title: VCF Protection and Recovery 9.1: Transition from standalone SRM and VR 9.0.2
factsPinned: Standalone Live Site Recovery 9.0.2 and vSphere Replication 9.0.2 must be removed before vCenter is upgraded from 8.0 U3 to 9.1.

For a minimal-footprint estate, active replication is deleted, both legacy appliances are unregistered and removed, vCenter is upgraded, and VCF Protection and Recovery 9.1.0.0.25367487 is freshly deployed before pairing and replication are recreated.

sources.title: Steps to Converge to VMware Live Recovery Appliance 9.0.4 (or newer) and Common Issues During Convergence
factsPinned: Live Site Recovery and vSphere Replication 9.0.2.2 or later can use the convergence path, while in-place upgrade to the combined appliance is not supported.
The protected and recovery sites must be treated together and pairing is restored only after both target appliances are ready.

sources.title: Update Sequence for VCF 9.0 and Compatible VMware Products
factsPinned: Core SDDC management planes follow SDDC Manager, NSX, vCenter, then ESXi ordering; NSX finalization runs with or after the ESXi stage.

sources.title: VMware Cloud Foundation 9 ESXi Host and NSX VIB Upgrade Consolidation
factsPinned: In VCF 9, NSX host VIBs are upgraded with ESXi rather than as an independent host-maintenance stage.

rules.description: Use the pinned 9.1.0.0 target versions for every component.
Import each site's existing core estate into fleet inventory before lifecycle upgrades.
At each site upgrade NSX, then vCenter, then ESXi and vSAN as one host/storage boundary.
Quiesce, unregister, and remove standalone 9.0.2 recovery appliances before vCenter 9.1.
Freshly deploy unified 9.1 protection and recovery at both sites, then pair and recreate replication.
Finish only after all inventory and recovery services report their pinned targets in one fleet.
